questionText:

order:

(B) Basavanna in Karnataka

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronology of religious teachers: (A) Appar (Tirunavukkarasar), one of the foremost Tamil Shaiva Nayanars, lived in the seventh century CE; (C) Nammalvar, the eminent Tamil Vaishnava Alvar poet, flourished in the ninth century CE; (D) Ramanujacharya, who systematized Vishishtadvaita Vedanta, lived between c. 1017 and 1137 CE; (B) Basavanna founded the Virashaiva/Lingayat movement in Karnataka in the mid-twelfth century CE. Sequence: (A), (C), (D), (B).
Hence, option (D) is correct.
